propositions: sign-review deterministically fails with store-read-failure when unrelated untracked files exist in the shared tracker, blocking plan claim and review-close gates despite valid PASS verdict
resign.py:146 calls generation.collect without passing ignore_untracked=True, causing strict git status check to fail on any untracked file regardless of content or name
orchestrator.py:650 silently falls back to full LLM re-review instead of drift-refresh probe when untracked files trigger collection failure within exception handler
attest.py:139 and attest.py:406 similarly omit ignore_untracked and abort signing on fallback paths when no initial generation snapshot is available
untracked files cannot change the committed-head fingerprint, so ignore_untracked=True preserves correctness while tracked-dirty state remains prohibited
fix verified to eliminate store-read-failure for untracked paths while retaining failures for tracked modifications, and confirms orchestrator probe no longer falls back due to untracked files
